in_sanskrit.name: Ram
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who delights, pleases, or brings joy. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'rama' which means 'to delight', 'to please', or 'to charm'. Often used as a divine name for the Hindu god Vishnu, particularly in the form Rama, the prince of Ayodhya and an avatar of Vishnu.

in_marathi.name: Ramdhari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramdhari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ramdhari is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi languages. It is a combination of two words: 'Ram' which means 'God of Gods' and 'Dhari' which means 'holder'. Thus, Ramdhari can be interpreted as 'the one who holds God'. It is a revered name in Hinduism and is used to pay respect to deities and gurus.
